notes.title: PATCH NOTE 05
notes.notes: [p][b]Attention, Patchê 05 is live![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve fixed a [b]bunch of things[/b] and gave the game a nice polish based on your feedback![/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s new?[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]You can now interact normally with objects like doors and the [i]boleadeira[/i][/p][/*][*][p]NPCs no longer disappear out of nowhere[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs won’t lie on the ground for no reason anymore[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs no longer block your way when stopping in front of houses or buildings[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/76bba584a4ea1e907d51a1621c7d79f59e0af186.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 03
notes.notes: [p]The Patch 03 is out! Many fixes and improvements have been made based on your feedback!![/p][p][/p][p]CORRECTED TOPICS:[/p][list][*][p]Implemented a button to reset the player's position[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a button to open the game's Discord server[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the tools "scissor" and "milk bucket" didn't work properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera rotation when the player enters/exits an interior[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed positioning issues with animals and NPCs, which could end up flying or falling out of the scene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem where a chicken could leave the scene or pass through fences when the gaucho collected an egg[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where horse race checkpoints remained active even after completion[/p][/*][*][p]Refined dialogue flow for exchanges with characters[/p][/*][*][p]Usability improvements for UI when using a gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements[/p][/*][/list][p]The upcoming updates are already in production, so if you want to chat or suggest something, join our Discord![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41240717/7007fe60a25e817eeab2f94022912a41f7d6bded.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for playing [b][i]Gaucho and the Grassland[/i][/b]![/p][p]We've been closely following everything you've been experiencing in the game, and that has been guiding our work over here. [/p][p][b]Patch 1.0[/b] is here, bringing quality of life [b]improvements[/b], important bug fixes, and adjustments to make your gameplay even better. [/p][p]And this is just the beginning. [b]New updates[/b] are already in the works, and your feedback is essential in this process. [/p][p][/p][p]💬 Want to contribute? Join our [b]Discord[/b] and come chat with us![/p][p][/p][p][b]FIXED ISSUES :[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where text would appear invisible in certain unsupported languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug causing repairable object panels to appear even after being fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Horse race finish lines now disappear properly after the race ends.[/p][/*][*][p]Torch mission in the mountains can now be completed normally.[/p][/*][*][p]Session screen now opens directly on the save tab to avoid accidental progress loss.[/p][/*][*][p]Different icons added for each dog skin type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where pre-placed items in the starting area couldn't be changed after loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Horse race softlocks have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements are now correctly tracked.[/p][/*][*][p]The Rose Maze can now only be completed once, and the monster moves again after collecting a rose.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs no longer block the player when exiting buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the names on village area signs.[/p][/*][*][p]House visuals in the Pampa now display properly at all distances.[/p][/*][*][p]The recipe for the mystical rod is now correctly given by the NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Horse skins have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]New names added to the credits.[/p][/*][*][p]Various other improvements and fixes.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]
